Language-flag classes — flag-img/flag-split for the SVG flag images, flag-canvas/flag-canvas--nav for the WebGL/2D-drawn flag surfaces in the locale picker. _B_FLAG_CANVAS is its own block so canvas variants (nav vs dialog sizing) key off --nav modifiers.
